title: Codwen session plan - the resume record
description: One canonical record of what a chat is doing, written before it builds or dispatches work and updated as it goes, so a stop - crash, sleep, another window, a model handover - is resumable. Read on a typed Continue (UserPromptSubmit hook), on a new chat (sessionStart hook) and by 'agentq plan'. It is the plan the agent must leave behind; the todo list, the subagent roster and the in-flight jobs are all fields here, not three separate truths.

nextStep.description: One actionable step. 'next' is an ordered list; resuming means doing next()[0] and never re-deriving it from the transcript.

owner.description: The agent that owns it, or 'self'.

rosterEntry.description: A subagent this chat dispatched (or planned to). This is what a resume re-dispatches without asking - the single biggest thing a Continue currently loses.

agentName.description: Researcher | Deep Build | ... - the exact picker name.

paths.description: Files this subagent owns; no two roster entries may share a file.

resultRef.description: Where the subagent's artifact landed, if any.

jobRef.description: An in-flight background job or cloud resource. Recorded the moment it launches; a lost id is orphaned spend.

id.description: agentq job id, or the cloud job / revision name.

planTask.description: A claimable unit in the live task store (state dir tasks/<id>.json), modelled on the agentq messages template. Claim/next/block/done operate on these.

owner.description: The session (lease) that claimed it; set atomically on claim.

trackerRef.description: Pointer back to the committed tracker row this task carries out.

handoffPrompt.description: The ready-to-paste next-chat prompt for this task (OQ-034).

plan.description: The session plan file: state dir chats/<sessionId>.plan.json.

goal.description: The outcome in one sentence - the thing 'Continue' must not lose.

doneMeans.description: 3-7 checks provable by command, test, query or live request.

constraints.description: Rules that must survive the reset (clean-tree deploys, shadow-until-green, ...).

handoff.description: The ready-to-paste new-chat prompt, when this chat is handing off.

handoffPath.description: The repository memory handoff file, e.g. /memories/repo/handoffs/<date>-<slug>.md.
